Name: Farmer's Market for TMX Loader
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Adds a weekend farmer's market to Pelican Town!
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Keeping in the spirit of a small rural town, Pelican Town now hosts a farmer's market on the weekends in the fall!  They'll only be open during good weather, so keep your eyes peeled.

This mod requires [TMX Loader](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820) (which in turn requires [PyTK](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)), as well as several JA packs.  See the links below.  The mod will __not__ run without all of the packs, as TMX Loader doesn't have a HasMod condition yet for shops.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  Install [PytK](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)﻿ and [TMX Loader](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820)﻿.

3.  Install [Artisan Valley](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926)﻿ and it's [dependencies](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1935)﻿, [Sweet Tooth](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1897)﻿, [Starbrew Valley](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1764)﻿, and [Eemie's Crops](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3523)﻿.

4.  Copy  the '[TMX] Farmer's Market' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

5.  Run the game using SMAPI, you're done!
Known Issues

*   The extra layers for TMXL do not currently work with map patches.  Because of this, the sprites had to be merged instead of layered properly.  This means a town recolor will not affect them.
